tech-stacks.react-dec: A declarative and efficient JavaScript library for building modern user interfaces, especially single-page applications (SPAs).
tech-stacks.next-dec: A React-based framework that provides hybrid rendering (SSR/SSG), automatic routing, and excellent performance for scalable web applications.
tech-stacks.tailwind-dec: A utility-first CSS framework that allows you to build responsive and modern layouts directly with classes, without leaving the markup.
tech-stacks.node-dec: A server-side JavaScript runtime environment used to build APIs, backend systems, and CLI tools with high performance.
tech-stacks.express-dec: A minimalist and flexible framework for Node.js, used to build APIs and web applications quickly and efficiently.
tech-stacks.type-dec: A superset of JavaScript that adds static typing to the code, helping prevent errors and improve application maintainability.
tech-stacks.prisma-dec: A modern ORM for Node.js and TypeScript that simplifies access to and manipulation of relational databases with type safety.
tech-stacks.mysql-dec: A widely used relational database management system known for its performance, reliability, and ease of use.
tech-stacks.java-dec: A robust, object-oriented, and cross-platform programming language widely used in enterprise applications and Android development.
tech-stacks.python-dec: A versatile, simple, and powerful programming language widely used for automation, data analysis, web development, and artificial intelligence.
